nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values: GoPro footage mounted low on the rear wing, extreme wide-angle fish-eye lens, rolling shutter distortion; Subject Physics: Porsche GT3 R, aggressive aerodynamic stance, massive lateral g-force causing driver's helmet visor to slightly fog and face muscles to strain, intense kinetic energy creating tire spray, rain deflecting off the carbon fiber body panels with high velocity and surface tension; Dynamic Environment: Dense plumes of water spray (aerosolized mist) trailing the car, blurring the background into a chaotic grey wall, standing water hydroplaning effect, micro-dust and rubber particles suspended in the heavy air; Lighting & Optical Artifacts: Blue/Purple Cold Lighting, intense saturated violet and cool blue light bathing the scene, harsh spotlights with a freezing, clinical cast, over-exposed sensor bloom on the bright flashing rain lights, extreme lens flare streak from trackside floodlights cutting through the spray, heavy lens dirt and water droplets distorting the image, strong digital noise/grain due to low light, chromatic aberration along the edge of the tire; Composition: Extreme low angle capturing the drama of the diffuser and the bottom of the car, subject slightly off-center and leaning into the apex, Dutch angle subtly conveying speed; Color & Atmosphere: Dominant cool clinical blues and violets, high saturation on the cold tones, high contrast between the neon rain lights and the deep shadows, wet tarmac texture reflecting the cold color grading.
